title: Corning's Gen AI Sales Double in Q3 as Revenue Hits $5.08B
summary:
Corning's adjusted earnings per share for the third quarter rose 36% year over year to $0.91, surpassing the $0.88 analyst estimate. The glassmaker reported revenue of $5.08B, which topped the forecast of $5.02B and represented a 19% increase from the previous year. The company's core gross margin improved to 40.5%, while its core operating margin reached 22.7%. Shares of Corning rose 3% in pre-market trading following the announcement.

The results were supported by the Optical Communications segment, which saw revenue jump 44% to $2.4B as Gen AI sales doubled during the quarter. Corning also secured four multibillion-dollar long-term contracts, including deals with AT&T and Verizon. Looking ahead, the company projects Q4 revenue between $5.2B and $5.3B and adjusted earnings per share between $0.96 and $1.00, above the $0.94 expected by analysts.
